items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: Look, I'll get Charlie Hamilton next week.

ctx.x: Well, you wouldn't make many chord changes in a whole number of them,

would you? No. This was supposed to be made, like an A flat, E flat 7, C sharp, D flat, whatever it is, B flat 7, E flat, and back to A flat. Well, this way you can improvise, you know, you make A flat, a couple of beats head, go up there and get A flat and modulate down to E flat 7, whatever it is, you see. They didn't want that damn man, Johnny Brown's the ribs, what's the same? Move out of that. He stopped playing his clarinet. Look, I'll get Charlie Hamilton next week. Or he'll get Red Louis, uh-oh, Emile…
But they get mad if you move off that corner.
